style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news
prompt: A blank ivory vellum stock certificate folio with an embossed red wax seal and a brass hinge clasp rests closed on a dark walnut desk, positioned off-centre on the thirds. 100mm macro lens at a razor-sharp focal plane, soft directional window light from the left rakes across the leather spine, leaving deep contact shadow. Palette bone white, charcoal graphite, brick red. Extreme close-up, shallow depth of field, fine film grain. No text, no lettering, no logos.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, illegible characters, embossed printed lettering
rationale: The story turns on the physical stock certificate and award paperwork itself—the artifact that carries the undisclosed equity grant term. A macro photograph isolates the blank, sealed folio and makes the absence of the published line tangible without relying on legible text, which the prior frame failed.
cue: the one the paperwork never publishes
subject: a blank ivory vellum stock certificate folio with an embossed red wax seal and brass clasp
core_thesis: Equity grants are growing fastest one level below senior and have stopped growing at the top, while exit offers are still priced in weeks of base pay — so the largest line in a senior package is the one the paperwork never publishes.
core_conflict: Fast-growing equity grants below director level collide with flat-to-shrinking director-level grants and cash severance caps, leaving the largest compensation component unprinted in the offer paperwork.
composition: extreme close-up, hero object off-centre on the thirds, shallow depth of field
